body:
The `NetCDFWriter different horizontal points` test makes the field it writes by deep-copying `Fields.coordinate_field(space).z` and adding to it in place. CliMA/ClimaCore.jl#2717 stores the local geometry of grids in `DataLayouts.InvariantArray`s, whose loads are marked invariant, so they cannot be modified. `copy` of a geometry field (like `similar` and broadcasts over it) returns a field of ordinary arrays, but `deepcopy` keeps the `InvariantArray`s, so the in-place update throws `ArgumentError: Cannot modify InvariantArray`.

This PR uses `copy` instead, which gives a field with the same values on the same space:
- With the current ClimaCore release (v1.0.8), `test/writers.jl` passes with identical results either way (every testset, including 18/18 in this one).
- With CliMA/ClimaCore.jl#2717, the `copy` version passes, and the `deepcopy` version fails this testset with the error above.

title: Copy instead of deep-copying a coordinate field in a writer test
